remarks: Single family home on approximately one acre with heated pool and two pool cottages available for rent. Hardwood floors throughout. No carpet. 3 bedrooms and 2 Waterworks renovated bathrooms - one en-suite w/ a shower and the other w/ a jacuzzi tub.  Petite yet gourmet kitchen has granite counter tops and high end stainless steel appliances - Viking, Miele, LG. Living room/great room has soaring ceilings, a stone fireplace and a wall of windows welcoming in the afternoon sunlight. Farrow & Ball paints used throughout the home. Central air conditioning. Fully fenced back yard centers around large in-ground heated Wagner gunite pool with mature plantings, unique trees and shrubs and professional landscaping. The two separate garden cottages are perfect for reading, relaxing and meditating.  Ample private parking. Dream location minutes from everything. Weekly rate is $4,500/week.
